The "Certificate of supplies from SEZ" shall contain the following details: (i) Name, Address and GSTIN of SEZ unit; (ii) GSTIN & Address of recipient unit of EPCG authorisation holder where capital goods would be installed; (iii) Name, description including specifications, where applicable, and quantity of items; and (iv) Individual value of items to be procured.
